answer: One concrete defense is a staked bond slashed on misbehavior. A sybil must post a separate bond per identity, so multiplying accounts multiplies locked capital. Think of a reef built polyp by polyp: each fake node needs its own costly deposit. A lone ember dies without fuel, and a single dune cannot hold back the sea; likewise, cheap aliases cannot sustain the bond. Slashing makes each fake identity a live liability, not a free clone.
